# base32

Encode and decode Base32 data through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/base32 input.txt

moonx cli/base32 --decode encoded.txt > decoded.txt

printf 'hello' | moonx cli/base32
```

With no file, or with - as the filename, read stdin. Encoding wraps at 76 characters by default; -w 0 disables wrapping and the trailing newline.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-d`, `--decode` | Decode input. |
| `-i`, `--ignore-garbage` | Ignore non-alphabet bytes when decoding. |
| `-w VALUE`, `--wrap VALUE` | Set output width; 0 disables wrapping and the final newline. Default: `76`. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- Decoding rejects lowercase characters unless -i discards them. Invalid input may produce partial output before an error.
- Encoding streams input; decoding reads the whole input into memory.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
